plan.title: Material PR to Split-Award RFQ PO

steps.note: Enable split awarding for the test company.
Enable the RFx project flow required by the PR conversion.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Give the event a searchable title required for publishing and later history verification.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.
Fill remaining mandatory event fields exposed by the create screen.

args.goal: set the RFQ evaluation duration to 30 minutes, add one required Terms and Conditions clause, and leave the event ready to publish

steps.note: Complete the buyer-side setup details not covered by a dedicated PR or schedule step.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B bidding.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Verify publishing reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's quote of 100 through the vendor portal, including the portal's T&C submission flow.
Verify Vendor A's bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's lower quote of 90 through the second vendor session.
Verify Vendor B's bid was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end before comparing and awarding bids.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify Vendor B, the vendor with the lower quote, is ranked first.
Verify ranks follow the lowest bid amount across both vendors.
Enter the award allocation screen.
Allocate 6 units of the line to Vendor B.
Allocate the remaining 4 units to Vendor A.
Verify both vendors are selected and the split proposal total is 6×90 + 4×100 = 940.
Verify the split award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for split award to Vendor B and Vendor A

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete the approved award flow and create the purchase orders.
Verify one PO line was created for each awarded vendor.
Return to the events list to verify the event entered history.
Open the event history tab.
Verify the created event appears in History.
